design.hypothesis: Replace variable threshold scaling at each arithmetic decision with one fixed high-aligned residual. Normalization shifts the residual, refill inserts the same big-endian word in the same cached phase. No decision, input bit, poll or cursor changes.
design.endState: One shared BlockReader representation for existing ordinary/live coefficient execution; same fields, no duplicated tree, owner, allocation, cache or public API.
design.acceptance: Independent scalar split/prefix/cursor tests, existing full coefficient/class/category/sign/quantization/window/tail/cancel oracles, exact packets and pixels. Current complete live and ordinary screens; independent original/candidate confirmations only if promising. A coherent accepted milestone requires affected costs and full normal/scalar Windows/Linux, actual same-package consumers.
design.tradeoffs: Normalization adds a variable residual shift and can lengthen the dependency chain. Code size or fewer threshold shifts alone do not establish CPU gain. Preserve adverse/inconclusive screens, restore byte-verified original sources/modules if unpromising.
